job_title: Senior Business Analyst / Assistant Project Manager (Information Technology)
description_html:
Uni-China (Business) Management Ltd. (“the Group”) and its subsidiaries have rooted in Hong Kong for approximately 30 years, being responsible for the operation and management of diverse businesses and adept at creating and maximizing values to the business itself and the society via revitalization projects.

The Group is a conglomerate with around 20 brands, covering diversified business areas which ranges from fresh food, revitalization of fresh markets, supermarket, food and beverage, project management, innovative technology and CRM solutions, integrated marketing to intelligent storage service with automated robotics technology.

Job Summary

The Assistant Project Manager supports the planning, execution, and delivery of IT projects related to corporate systems such as ERP, HR, Finance, and Leasing systems. This role works closely with project managers, business stakeholders, technical teams and external vendors to ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned with business objectives.


Key responsibilities

●       Assist in project planning, scheduling, and coordination of project activities.

●       Support the Project Manager in tracking project progress, milestones, and deliverables.

●       Coordinate with cross-functional teams including developers, business analysts, vendors, and end users.

●       Facilitate requirement gathering, documentation, and validation with business stakeholders.

●       Monitor risks, issues, and dependencies, and escalate when necessary.

●       Prepare project documentation such as status reports, meeting minutes, and project plans.

●       Support system implementation, testing (UAT), and deployment activities.

●       Ensure proper change management and communication throughout the project lifecycle.

●       Assist in post-implementation support and continuous improvement initiatives.


Job Requirements

●       Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or related disciplines.

●       3 years of experience in IT project coordination or project support roles.

●       Familiarity with enterprise systems such as ERP, HRIS, Finance, or Leasing platforms.

●       Basic understanding of project management methodologies (e.g., Agile, Waterfall).

●       Strong organizational and multitasking skills with attention to detail.

●       Good communication and stakeholder management skills.

●       Proficiency in tools such as Microsoft Project, Excel, PowerPoint, and collaboration platforms.

●       Experience with data-related tools (e.g., SQL, Power BI tools) is an advantage.

●       Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

●       PMP or related certifications are a plus.


Job Offers

  • Competitive Salary Package

  • Guaranteed Double Pay

  • Group Medical Scheme

  • Birthday Leave

  • Marriage Leave

job_title: IT Manager, Systems and Operations [Ref. IT/202601]
company_name: HONG KONG NEW EMERGING TECHNOLOGY EDUCATION CHARITY FOUNDATION
description_html:
IT Manager, Systems and Operations [Ref. IT/202601]

DUTIES

1. Core Systems and Project Implementation

  • Coordinate the selection, deployment, and launch of core IT systems, including but not limited to student information, finance, HR, and learning management systems.

  • Track IT project progress, organise meetings, document and provide feedback on issues to ensure projects progress as planned.

  • Identify implementation risks and practical solutions, and provide timely updates and recommendations to management.

2. Vendor, Consultant, and Procurement Coordination

  • Serve as the Foundation's primary IT point of contact, working closely with external IT consultants, service providers, and system vendors to jointly advance the Foundation's IT development.

  • Participate in requirement gathering, helping external teams understand the Foundation's needs and ensuring deliverables meet actual usage scenarios.

  • Follow up on vendor progress, coordinate internal and external resources to complete system deployment, network construction, server room setup, and other project tasks.

  • Review the quality of vendor deliverables, including documentation, configurations, and test reports, and assume initial acceptance responsibilities.

3. IT Operations and User Support

·       Handle daily IT operations, including user account management, access permissions, software and hardware installation, troubleshooting and escalation.

·       Support the Foundation’s network, Wi-Fi, printing services, meeting room equipment, office automation tools and other basic IT services.

·       Respond to IT requests, maintain issue records and follow up with users and external support teams as needed.

·       Maintain an accurate inventory of IT assets, including computers, monitors, mobile devices, software licences and peripherals.

4. IT Compliance, Security and Documentation Management

  • Assist in implementing basic data security and privacy protection measures in accordance with Hong Kong's Personal Data (Privacy) Ordinance (PDPO) and other relevant requirements.

  • Manage various IT-related passwords, system configurations, network topology diagrams, vendor contact lists, and other important documents to ensure complete and traceable records.

  • Cooperate with external audits or internal reviews by providing required IT records and explanations.

5. Other Duties and Continuous Improvement

  • Provide IT support for events, system demonstrations, user training and other Foundation activities as required.

  • Proactively identify potential IT issues or areas for operational improvement, propose feasible solutions and support implementation.

  • Perform other IT-related duties assigned by the Foundation as its operations develop.   


REQUIREMENTS

  1. A bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science, or a related discipline; equivalent practical experience will also be considered.

  2. At least five years of relevant IT experience, preferably in a generalist IT, systems implementation, IT operations or project coordination role.

  3. Experience in a small-to-medium organisation, start-up environment, education institution or non-profit organisation would be an advantage.

  4. Relevant experience in coordinating the implementation or operation of business-critical systems, such as student information, learning management, finance, HR, CRM or similar enterprise systems.

  5. Good understanding of system integration, identity and access management, networking fundamentals, cloud computing, end-user support, and IT asset management.

  6. Strong coordination and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with management, users, external consultants and vendors.

  7. Practical, adaptable and solution-oriented, with the ability to work in a developing organisation with evolving requirements and limited resources.

  8. Detail-oriented, responsible, organised, proactive and able to work independently.

  9. Comfortable working in a lean organisation as the Foundation’s core internal IT representative, with support from external consultants and vendors.

  10. Good command of spoken and written Chinese (Cantonese and Putonghua) and English, with the ability to read English technical documentation and communicate with vendors.

  11. Holding basic IT certifications (e.g., CompTIA, Microsoft, Cisco entry-level). Familiarity with the Hong Kong education sector's IT environment is an advantage.

APPLICATION

To apply, please submit the completed application form (Download from our website: https://hknetecf.org/en/careers/it-manager-system-202601) with copies of academic credentials and professional qualifications by email to the Foundation (hr•@hknetecf.org) by 10 July 2026.

Please quote job reference no. on the email subject.

job_title: IT Specialist / IT Project Coordinator (EV Charging App Initiative)
description_html:
Key responsibilities:

  • External Liaison & Regulatory Compliance:

    • Act as the primary point of contact with relevant Government Departments, particularly EPD, to ensure the application and charging infrastructure comply with all local regulations.

    • Coordinate with various EV Charging Service Providers, Wireless Network Service Providers, and Payment Service Providers to integrate their systems and networks into the BYD app ecosystem.

    • Manage communication with Certification Authorities to secure the necessary approvals and certifications for the app and associated hardware.

  • Internal Coordination & Project Management:

    • Collaborate closely with the internal IT Department to oversee app development, testing cycles, and deployment schedules.

    • Work with the Corporate Communications Department to align the app's features with the company's brand narrative and marketing strategies.

    • Partner with the Customer Experience (CX) Team to incorporate user feedback, ensuring the app is intuitive and offers attractive privileges and benefits for BYD customers.

  • Technical & Administrative Support:

    • Assist in defining technical specifications and user stories for the app development.

    • Prepare regular project reports, meeting minutes, and presentation decks.

    • Conduct market research and analysis to identify user trends and app enhancements.


Requirements:

  • Education: Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline.

  • Experience: Minimum of 5 years of relevant working experience, preferably in IT project coordination, software development lifecycle management, or a similar role. Experience in the automotive, energy, or e-mobility sector is a distinct advantage.

  • Technical Skills:

    • Proficiency in prevailing software programming languages and app writing frameworks.

    • Strong understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) and Agile methodologies.

    • Familiarity with database management, API integration, and UI/UX principles is a plus.

  • Language Skills:

    • Fluent in Cantonese and Putonghua to liaise effectively with local stakeholders and headquarters.

    • Strong proficiency in English for technical documentation and professional communications.

  • Software Proficiency:

Advanced skills in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

We are looking for someone who:

  • Possesses excellent communication and interpersonal skills to manage diverse stakeholder relationships.

  • Has strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

  • Is a team player with a proactive and "can-do" attitude.

  • Is passionate about new energy vehicles and smart city development
